tools.name: scansdk_u100_match_device

Always read deviceScope in the response and remind the user to confirm device model before implementation.

instructions: ScanSDK-U100 dedicated hardware scanner documentation (ScannerSDK, serial port, symbology & device config). Applies ONLY to devices matching: 69PC, U100, SK100. When user mentions U100, 69PC, SK100, 扫码, 扫码窗, 码制, ScannerSDK, 串口扫码, 感应模式, symbology, or ScanSDK — use scansdk_u100_* tools here, NOT urovosdk Scanner (InnerScannerImpl). UrovoSDK Scanner is camera-based POS scan UI; this server is hardware ScanSDK-U100 config & API.
